One of Electric 10s's top prizes was claimed last week. A player in Texas won $30,000. The game started with six top prizes and now has five top prizes. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.

The numbers for "Electric 10s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2772.headline: The top prize list got shorter

2773.body:
On "Sugar Skull Cash", one $100,000 top prize was claimed yesterday. That leaves two of the original four. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

If you play "Sugar Skull Cash" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2773.headline: Someone claimed a $100,000 prize

2774.body:
"The Price is Right™" just went on sale in Texas. The game has eleven full prize levels with four top prizes of $250,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

If you play "The Price is Right™" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
